original_annotations: Find and open a product page for the same portable LED work light shown in the video. Use the brand visible on the light and the device type to locate the exact item on Amazon.

observed_events.description: Two illuminated portable work lights with broad rectangular central panels and side panels stand on the work surfaces. The wearer handles a paint tray and brush while the viewpoint changes. The released interval does not show carrying the light, adjusting its panels, tripod feet, or a verified exact model.

unsupported_claims: An exact equipment model or unsupported mounting structure.
The user-reported difficulty or future plan is shown in the video.

screening.instruction_provenance: Authored next-room purchasing need and battery ownership, not recorded dialogue or visually inferred brand.
screening.source_review: Reuse the source interval and frame provenance of c114; constructor inspected all eight released views plus the existing continuous-interval inspection. Only static panel arrangement is asserted, not adjustment, battery type or exact model.

supported_claims.text: The work light has three illuminated rectangular panels arranged across one unit; the middle panel is broader and the two side panels are narrower. The wearer is preparing to paint with a tray and brush.

unsupported_claims: Exact original brand/model, battery type, output, tripod and adjustment operation are not established.
The later battery ownership and next-room plan are authored user needs.

construct.research_question: Can the Agent preserve a visually specified work-light layout while applying the user's battery-platform requirement?
construct.belief_before: One work light with the visible three-panel row; no exact model, relative panel size, colour, stand or power-source restriction.
construct.belief_after: The same layout, powered by the user's DeWalt 20V batteries; either verified stand/no-stand listing is acceptable.
construct.required_behavior_change: Replace a built-in-battery or mains light when necessary; retain a compatible selection.
construct.no_update_failure: Leave a built-in-battery or mains-only light after the battery-platform update.
construct.overupdate_failure: Choose a single-head or radial multi-panel DeWalt-compatible lamp and lose the visual layout requirement.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The words never name panel count or arrangement. The window contains many different DeWalt-compatible shapes; the scene selects the horizontal three-panel form.

observed.why: Battery compatibility narrows the legal lights while the scene-derived panel layout remains unchanged.
